title: Jesus is the King
textBlocks:
The ISRAELITES needed to be RESCUED
BUT THE PEOPLE SAW IT DIFFERENTLY
When Jesus rode into JERSUSALEM on a DONKEY
(even though they shouted - The KING who comes in the name of the Lord is the blessed one)
They thought that Jesus would RESCUE them from the ROMANS
They didn’t undertstand that JESUS would RESCUE them from DEATH!

Many years before Jesus was even born, the prophets told that a savior, a King would come to Jerusalem on a donkey.
BUT THE MEAN HARD HEARTED AND BLINDED PHARISEES couldn’t see this
even though they knew what was written in the scriptures
THEY TOLD JESUS TO MAKE HIS DISCIPLES KEEP QUIET
But Jesus told them that if they kept quiet stones would praise him
THIS MAD THE PHARISEES ANGRY
Can you see the big picture?
